checklist.answers: Named adapter command + protocol version + schema digests; handshake transcript location; truthful capability advertisement and how misadvertisement fails closed.
Seat/actor projection function; per-principal redaction rules; metadata channels enumerated as leakage boundary; honeycard sentinel placement.

Full discretionary-family inventory (priority/target/choose-object/target-amount/mulligan/choose-use/choice/pile/mana-payment/announce-x/multi-amount/replacement-effect/trigger-order/choose-mode/choose-ability/declare-attacker/declare-blocker/concede or engine equivalents) with engine seam per family; seven prohibited shortcuts proven unsatisfying.
Engine commit/tree/version + adapter commit/tree + license SPDX + blob digests + card-DB/Oracle snapshot identity; single SOURCE_LOCK record; rebuild procedure.
Named RNG algorithms; root-seed input; Rules-vs-pilot attribution log (RulesRngTape shape); deterministic seed-derivation rule; explicit-seed fail-closed behavior.
Actor-scoped observation proof per hidden zone (hand/library/face-down/manifest); reveal/look audience logs; transcript redaction check; honeycard negative runs.
One game per clean process; fresh-JVM (or equivalent) procedure; no shared mutable state across games; atomic artifact writes; process-identity exclusion from semantic hashes.

Decision tape + event tape + RNG tape schemas; checkpoint/restore points; clean-process replay consumer; divergence taxonomy; tamper matrix (minimum: dropped/reordered/mutated/forged tape actions fail closed and leak-free).

Fixture driver: RUN_FIXTURE request/response mapping per category (player-count, WS05-*, pilot, negatives, hidden, replay/RNG, micro, actual-card); seed policy (frozen 424242 + distinct-seed twins); actor/viewer binding; artifact-hash capture.

Unknown/unsupported decision => explicit fail-closed error (never default/skip/random); stale-revision rejection; malformed-request rejection; >scope shapes (e.g. oversized targets) fail closed with named errors.

Sealed per-fixture rows (verdict + evidence_class + reason + artifact_hashes) under evidence-vocab-v1; legacy prose only via versioned map; manifest-hash refresh in the same commit as any seal-covered edit.

No XMage Java API names, no Forge controller class names, no UUID-format mandates, no single-engine RNG method, no single-engine callback taxonomy in the adapter contract. Deviations listed as mapping-layer notes, never as standard changes.

note: H01-H12 are semantic requirements. A new engine answers each with its own mechanism; reviewers check the answers against the admission stage contract, never against an incumbent implementation.
